ios.desc:
Pause a campaign, move a budget, or launch a new one, from your phone.
Ask the built-in AI consultant what changed and what to fix next.
The account you run from a desk goes where you go.

ASK YOUR AI CONSULTANT
Ask a question in plain English and get answers and concrete recommendations from your own live data: where spend went, what changed, what to fix first. Charts arrive on demand, drawn in the app from your real numbers, and every recommendation links straight to the screen where you act on it. For subscribers, with a free preview for everyone.

GET AN ALERT WHEN SPEND GOES NOWHERE
Once a week, with nobody watching, your consultant reads the account again. If it finds spend that is bringing no installs, you get one notification saying how much and what kind of thing it is attached to, and the full finding waits in the Assistant with a link to the screen where you fix it. Silence means the account looks fine. Alerts are a Consultant Tier benefit; Management Tier subscribers see the same weekly finding when they open the app.

MANAGE WHAT IS ALREADY RUNNING
Pause, enable, or rename a campaign. Adjust daily budgets and budget orders. Edit keywords and bids, ad groups, and targeting. Every write is confirmed, and a failure tells you what happened rather than pretending it worked.

CONNECT WITHOUT A KEY ON YOUR PHONE
An admin grants access in the Apple Ads console, and a secure backend holds the organization's key and mints short-lived tokens. There is nothing to paste, store, or keep safe on the device. Access is scoped to the one organization you connect and stays revocable from Apple's console.

LAUNCH A CAMPAIGN END TO END
Pick an app, name the campaign and set its budget, choose bidding and schedule, add locations and audience, add the keywords you want to bid on, choose the product page, then review and launch. Every step lives on the phone.

SEE WHAT IT COST
A dashboard leads with total spend, installs, average CPA, and conversion rate, over any preset or custom date range and in your organization's own reporting time zone, so the numbers match the Apple Ads console. Ask the Assistant for any breakdown or comparison and get a chart on the spot, so you know what happened and what it cost before you are back at a desk.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO RUN ADS
Solo developers on their own app, agency staff covering client accounts, and in-house managers who cannot wait until the next time they open a laptop.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Manage Apple (Search) Ads From Your Phone

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I’m Remington, a professional developer and indie builder. I created App Ads Manager, an iOS app that lets you fully manage Apple Search Ads campaigns directly on your iPhone or iPad.

The problem: Apple’s web UI is slow and frustrating on mobile, and you often need a laptop to quickly pause campaigns, adjust bids, or fix keywords. Delays mean wasted budget.

With App Ads Manager, you can create and edit campaigns (Today Tab, Search Tab, Product Pages, Search Results), adjust budgets and bids, edit keywords (including negatives), and track performance data right from your phone.

It supports advanced targeting (location, age, gender, device type), bulk keyword editing, and custom product pages. Campaign metrics like impressions, taps, installs, and spend are easy to access and filter.

All credentials are encrypted and synced via Apple’s official Search Ads API. No data is logged or stored on our servers.

I release updates at least once a week based on feedback, and there is a small Discord community for support and sharing ideas.

If you run Apple Search Ads and want to manage them on the go, I’d love for you to try it. You can download it now, connect your Apple Ads account, and start managing.

Curious to hear how you handle ad optimization when away from your desk and what features you would like to see next.

Thanks for reading!

Remington
